finePrint.summary: Lifetime-deal buyer gets one-time-payment access to all current features plus any future features with no subscription.

quote.text: Get lifetime access to all features we offer today, plus any new feature we add in the future. One-time payment. No subscription, no add-ons.

finePrint.summary: Shared links can only be used once by default, limiting reuse of secrets.

quote.text: The links are encrypted with SSL and can only be used once by default.

finePrint.summary: The Solo individual plan is listed at €49 one-time plus taxes.

quote.text: For individuals who need to share sensitive information the secure way.

finePrint.summary: The Business team plan is listed at €129 one-time plus taxes with unlimited team members.

quote.text: For small and big teams, with unlimited team members. Bring as many as you need.

finePrint.summary: Support is offered via in-product chat with best-effort fast replies in English and German.

quote.text: We try our best to answer support tickets in a short time. To reach us, use our in-product chat.

finePrint.summary: The platform is marketed as GDPR-compliant with AES-256 encryption and made/hosted in Germany.

quote.text: GDPR compliant platform with strong AES-256 encryption. Made in Germany.
